description: Arctic Trail Tier-3 Fast-SAR Jet-Hybrid ('arctic-fast-sar-jet', 14.95 kg Airborne MTOW, Pre-Flight-Test Engineering Concept). Combines (1) Iteration 1 Fixed 16-deg Cranked Wing (2,200 mm span, AR=7.62, continuous 20 mm carbon tubular spar with 72-deg ground-only transport fold pins), (2) Twin-Boom 110-deg Inverted V-Tail (Lambda-tail) bridging outside the central jet plume, (3) High-Visibility RAL 2005 Fluorescent SAR Orange livery + passive corner/Luneburg ATC radar reflector (+5 to +10 dBsm) + ADS-B Out / FLARM / Remote ID, (4) Turnkey German JetCat P100-RX-BL (100 N) / Spanish Xicoy X132 COTS propulsion with 304SS + 10 mm silica-aerogel thermal deck, and (5) 420x180x145 mm gasketed CG payload bay (X_CG = 595.0 mm) delivering a 5.0 kg survival capsule (RESTUBE 180 flotation + 3 L +42 C warm hydration + thermal bivvy + PLB) during a slowed 25-28 m/s parachute pass with 0.0 mm CG shift.
